figures_differ: Measured on the evidence shipped with this tool: 61 of 138 findings on targets that report tool calls do not appear at all when only the reply is read.

The same guard that blocked that document also refused 6 of 9 ordinary customer questions on the affected topics. A defence that answers “no” to your customers is a number you want before you ship, not after.

, so a count of findings measures the application rather than the attacker. One of the three tools says that in its report. On the guarded target all three score zero by the shared rule and we were the only one to find anything at all, one breach in 324, while that same deployment refuses 38 of 48 ordinary customer questions. The page publishes where the other two are better, and a claim we withdrew after a reviewer asked for a p-value.

strings.We re-sent the same messages to that gua: 同じメッセージをそのガードレールに送り直したところ、常に自分自身と一致するわけではありませんでした。同一の入力に対して五つの言い回しが異なる判定を受け、ごく普通の質問が十二回中十回通されました。ですから私たちは、何回の試行が破ったかを報告し、一回でも破ったかどうかは報告しません。一度の実行は一日の物語にすぎず、それはきれいな結果についても悪い結果と同じく当てはまります。私たち自身の結果も含めて。

strings.And beside two other tools, in public: そして他の二つのツールと並べて、公開の場で
